exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.cues: Seat height aligned with mid-chest; wrists straight; elbows at 45 degrees; exhale on press.

exercises.name: Seated Lat Pulldown
exercises.cues: Wide grip; slight 10-degree torso lean; pull bar down to clavicle; squeeze shoulder blades down.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.cues: Neutral grip handle; chest tall; pull toward lower ribs; don't round lower back.

exercises.name: Cable Torso Rotation
exercises.cues: Chest-height cable; pivot back foot; rotate torso using core power (punching rotation mechanic).

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor & Psoas Lunge
exercises.cues: Back knee on mat; tuck pelvis under; push hips gently forward; reach same-side arm overhead.

exercises.name: Wall Shoulder & Lat Extension
exercises.cues: Hands flat on wall at shoulder height; hinge back and sink chest downward; breathe deeply.

exercises.name: Swim Warm-Up
exercises.cues: 100m easy freestyle or breaststroke. Focus on relaxed breathing and long gliding strokes.

exercises.name: Freestyle Stamina Sets
exercises.cues: 4 x 50m steady aerobic pace (RPE 6/10). Rest 30 seconds after each 50m.

exercises.name: Kickboard Drills (Karate Kick Prep)
exercises.cues: 4 x 25m kickboard flutter kick or breaststroke whip kick. Keep hips high near the water surface.

exercises.name: Swim Cool-Down
exercises.cues: 100m slow backstroke or relaxed breaststroke to lower heart rate.

exercises.name: Dry Heat Sauna
exercises.cues: 10–12 minutes. Sit on a clean towel. Step out if dizzy. Take a cool shower immediately after.

exercises.name: Seated Butterfly Stretch
exercises.cues: Soles together, heels close to pelvis; spine straight; gently press knees toward mat.

exercises.name: Frog Stretch
exercises.cues: On hands and knees, widen knees as far apart as comfortable, feet turned out; gently rock hips back.

exercises.name: Seated Straddle Stretch
exercises.cues: Wide V-legs; walk fingertips forward from hips keeping back flat. Restores roundhouse/side kick range.

exercises.name: Pigeon Stretch
exercises.cues: Front shin across mat, back leg straight; square hips forward; lower torso onto forearms.

exercises.name: Thoracic Thread-the-Needle
exercises.cues: Hands and knees; thread right arm under torso until shoulder rests on mat; exhale and twist.

exercises.name: Wet Steam Bath & Hydrotherapy
exercises.cues: 8–10 minutes in steam room followed by warm spa jet tub. Perform slow neck and wrist rolls.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Press Machine
exercises.cues: Feet shoulder-width in middle of footplate; push through heels and mid-foot; never lock knees at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Leg Curl
exercises.cues: Adjust roller pad right above Achilles; pull heels beneath seat; control the return slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Extension Machine
exercises.cues: Back flat against pad; extend legs fully; squeeze quads for 1 second at top; slow negative.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
exercises.cues: Forearms braced on pads; pull knees up to chest without swinging; control descent.

exercises.name: Hamstring Pike Stretch
exercises.cues: Sit with legs straight; reach hands toward ankles or toes keeping chest open; avoid severe hunching.

exercises.name: Sprint & Recovery Intervals
exercises.cues: 4 x 25m fast sprint (rest 45s between laps), followed by 2 x 100m smooth aerobic pace.

exercises.name: Light Dumbbell Goblet Squat
exercises.cues: Hold dumbbell vertically at chest; elbows inside knees at bottom; feet slightly turned out.

exercises.name: Seated Machine Overhead Press
exercises.cues: Seat adjusted so handles align with chin; press up without arching lower back; slow descent.

exercises.name: Machine Pec Fly / Rear Delt
exercises.cues: Slight elbow bend; squeeze arms together in front of chest; hold peak contraction for 1 second.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.cues: Elbows under shoulders; tuck tailbone; squeeze glutes and brace stomach like expecting a kick.
